blocks.text: Coleman Wong will be eagerly checking his phone for a message from Rafael Nadal after the Hong Kong player won tennis gold at the Asian Games on Saturday, and with it a place at the Olympics. Wong beat Wu Yibing 6-2, 6-4 and joins Wu’s fellow Chinese Wang Xiyu, who won the women’s final, as singles champions in Nagoya. The 22-year-old Wong is the first man from Hong Kong to win tennis gold. READ: US Open: Coleman Wong, friend of Alex Eala’s also advances Top seed. Top of the podium.
